scope: Local front-facing militia graphics and motion study; not installed into the gameplay rig.

prompts.walk: Create a production-quality transparent PNG sprite animation sheet for Crownforge's Crown Militia. Use the attached lore portrait as the character identity and clothing reference, NOT a background. Exactly EIGHT full-body frames in a perfectly regular FOUR columns by TWO rows grid. Entire canvas transparent alpha, no backdrop, no floor, no shadows outside silhouettes, no text, no labels, no grid lines. Canvas landscape 2048x1536 if possible. Each cell same size with generous margins, boots on identical baseline, same camera, same body height. Camera isometric three-quarter front, facing screen lower-right, orthographic game sprite. One rugged adult human man, short curly dark hair, light stubble, teal quilted gambeson, dark brown leather shoulder guards and belt, knee length split teal cloth, brown fitted trousers and practical leather boots. Small gold crown pin. Carries a single solid iron flanged mace in RIGHT hand and round wood planked iron-rimmed shield on LEFT forearm; consistent weapons and hands in all frames. Rich crisp premium painterly realism, sculptural anatomy, readable chunky silhouette, sharp cloth seams and metal edge highlights, restrained colors, ordinary heroic mortal militia not a knight. Eight consecutive evenly spaced WALK CYCLE poses in reading order: 1 right heel forward left toe back; 2 right foot planted knees compress; 3 left leg passing right leg; 4 left leg lifts forward; 5 left heel forward right toe back; 6 left foot planted knees compress; 7 right leg passing left leg; 8 right leg lifts to return seamlessly to frame 1. Actually alternate the legs; do not repeat identical poses. Subtle opposing shoulder rotation, shield stable on arm, mace controlled pendulum, coat tails follow steps. Body stays centered within each cell; no crop of any mace/boots/head/shield. This is an animation sprite sheet, not an illustration collage. Preserve genuine alpha transparency.
prompts.attack: Using the attached militia WALK sprite sheet as exact identity, costume, lighting and camera reference, create a MATCHING ATTACK animation sprite sheet. Exactly eight full body sequential poses in FOUR columns and TWO rows, regular equal cells, transparent alpha background, no text, no grid, no ground. Same rugged man short curly black hair light stubble, teal quilted gambeson, leather pauldrons, split teal coat, brown trousers boots, wood iron-rimmed shield in LEFT hand and iron flanged mace in RIGHT hand. Same apparent character height and fixed isometric three quarter front camera facing lower-right in ALL cells; character stays centered, room above and to sides for weapon swing. Full boots/head/mace/shield entirely inside each cell. A powerful grounded swing with real leg support and spine rotation: frame1 planted guard feet apart mace upright near right shoulder, shield forward; frame2 hips wind back and right elbow rises; frame3 mace lifted overhead behind right shoulder, shield tucked; frame4 beginning downward diagonal swing, torso rotation; frame5 impact mace extended down-forward toward lower-right, knees flexed and shield guards chest; frame6 followthrough mace below waist toward front left, torso follows; frame7 withdraw weapon with feet planted; frame8 return to frame1 guard. Eight DISTINCT poses that describe one continuous attack, same face, same gear, no duplicated weapons, no trails, no sparks, no extra hands. High detail crisp painterly realism, readable joints and hands with exact grips, genuine alpha transparency. Landscape sheet.

notes: Original generated RGBA PNGs copied intact. Frame rectangles measured from alpha components. No background removal, repainting, or source pixel alteration. Remaining facings, death, hit, and gameplay integration await design review.
